excluded_latest_qwen_models.reason: 360GB BF16, requires CPU/offload plus special gated residual and n-gram attribution; not selected for the single-H20 four-checkpoint design.
4.89TB BF16 or 2.50TB FP8 exceeds available CPU RAM; disk capacity alone does not make full white-box execution feasible.

verification_notes: HF official API accessed locally with curl --http1.1 -4; plain urllib IPv6 path reset.
Remote HF HTTPS timed out; remote official ModelScope config endpoint was reachable.
Every weight LFS SHA256 and byte size is from the fixed official HF checkpoint metadata.

candidate_models.precision: official mixed FP8/FP4 plus BF16/F32; not plain BF16 and not a separate scale per precision
candidate_models.bf16_estimate_caveat: Planning estimate only; HF total includes auxiliary/speculative components and quantization bookkeeping. Actual converted resident bytes must be measured.
candidate_models.native_hf_status: not_in_transformers_5.17.0; official reference forward runs inference_mode and TileLang forward kernels
blockers: Single H20 cannot retain the full checkpoint; requires validated CPU/offload implementation.
Inference success alone does not establish gradients through compressed attention, MoE, and residual mixers.
Full Adam training state is beyond this node; adapter training still requires backbone input gradients.

google_family_audit.Gemini: Current official catalog lists API endpoints, including gemini-3.8-flash; no publicly downloadable Gemini model checkpoint was identified in official model docs. Gemini API does not provide the local weight/activation/gradient access required here.
google_family_audit.Gemma: Google explicitly identifies Gemma as the open-model family based on research/technology used for Gemini; Gemma4 is not a model called Gemini.

runtime_precision_note: The per-model dtype describes original checkpoint storage. Actual main policy execution is FP32, pinned in main_protocol.json and policy_runtime_gates.json.
